units.source_text: 只要没有接到先生的明确回复，我就不能这样去想，也自然没有勇气说什么。

en.t: As long as I had not received a clear reply from Sensei, I could not think that way, and naturally I had no courage to say anything about it.

units.source_text: 可是母亲一厢情愿地对大家这样吹了出来，事已至此，我也不好马上否认了。

en.t: But Mother had taken it upon herself to tell everyone as if it were settled, and now that things had come this far, I could not very well deny it at once.

units.source_text: 无须母亲催促，我一直在等候先生的回信。

en.t: Even without Mother urging me, I had been waiting all along for Sensei's reply.

units.source_text: 盼望着这封信能带来家人所期待的介绍工作的事，那就好了。

en.t: I hoped that the letter would bring news of the job introduction my family was expecting; if it did, that would be best.

units.source_text: 在濒死的父亲面前，在一心祈祷着为父亲求得哪怕一点儿安宁的母亲面前，

en.t: Before my father, who was on the verge of death, and before my mother, who was praying with all her heart to give him even a little peace,

units.source_text: 在认为不做事便枉为人的哥哥面前，在妹夫、叔叔、婶子等人面前，我不能不为自己不以为然的态度而自责。

en.t: before my elder brother, who thought a man was worthless if he did not work, and before my brother-in-law, uncle, aunt, and the others, I could not help reproaching myself for my indifferent attitude.

units.source_text: 当父亲呕吐出奇怪的黄色东西时，我想起了先生和夫人曾经说过的那种危险。

en.t: When my father vomited up a strange yellow substance, I remembered the danger Sensei and his wife had once spoken of.

units.source_text: “躺了那么久，胃口还不变坏了。”母亲说。

en.t: After lying in bed so long, of course his stomach would go bad, Mother said.

units.source_text: 我望着母亲那懵懂无知的脸，眼里涌出了泪水。

en.t: Looking at Mother's innocent, unknowing face, tears welled up in my eyes.

units.source_text: 哥哥在起居室遇到我时，问道：“你听见了吗？”

en.t: When my elder brother met me in the sitting room, he asked, Did you hear?

units.source_text: 他指的是医生临走时对他说的话。

en.t: He meant what the doctor had said to him as he was leaving.

units.source_text: 其实，用不着听医生说什么，我早就知道父亲那样呕吐意味着什么了。

en.t: In truth, I did not need to hear anything from the doctor; I already knew what it meant for Father to vomit like that.

units.source_text: “你有没有打算回老家来，打理家里这摊事？”哥哥回过头来望着我说。

en.t: Have you thought about coming back home and taking charge of things here? my elder brother said, turning to look at me.

units.source_text: “这么多事，妈一个人哪成啊。”哥哥又说。

en.t: With so much to deal with, Mother cannot manage alone, my elder brother said again.

units.source_text: 哥哥似乎认为，我就是终老于家乡也毫不可惜。

en.t: My elder brother seemed to think there would be nothing regrettable if I spent the rest of my life in my hometown.
